content.short: ION Finance is a hybrid DEX on TON combining order books with AMMs for a professional trading experience in Telegram.
content.description: ION Finance is an innovative decentralized exchange on TON that utilizes a hybrid liquidity model, combining a Central Limit Order Book (CLOB) with traditional Automated Market Maker (AMM) mechanics. This approach provides traders with the precision of limit orders alongside the accessibility of liquidity pools. Designed to operate seamlessly within the Telegram interface, ION Finance offers a professional-grade trading experience that is both powerful and highly accessible to the massive global audience of the messaging platform.
content.meta: Experience hybrid trading with ION Finance on TON. Order books and AMMs combined on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
